results.description:
One public disaster. One arrogant NFL star. And a reality TV contract that might be the biggest mistake of her life

Zara Morgan was Hollywood’s golden girl—until a leaked video and a spectacular public meltdown turned her into a cautionary tale.

With her career in freefall and no second chances left, she signs on to The Final Play, a wildly popular reality dating show pairing disgraced starlets like her with pro football athletes.

Her plan is simple: keep her head down, repair her image, and survive the season.

Then she meets Jaxon Wilde.

Jaxon isn't just an arrogant pro-bowler; he’s a master of the game. He knows Zara wants out, so he keeps her in—handing her the golden rose week after week just to watch her squirm under the spotlight.

Winning the final rose should be a triumph. Instead, it’s a PR nightmare.

Now contractually bound to fake a six-month romance, Zara and Jaxon must sell a love story for the world—while off camera, the sparks and clashes feel dangerously real. With scandals resurfacing and reputations on the line, they’ll have to decide what matters more: protecting their image…or risking their hearts.

Enemies Off Camera is a sizzling enemies-to-lovers sports romance featuring fake dating, forced proximity, and enough reality TV drama to set your screen on fire.
